instruction: Check the OneStopShop customer reviews for kids sunscreens. A product qualifies only if the reviews explicitly support both criteria: it does not sting and it does not feel sticky. Add the qualifying product to the cart. If more than one product qualifies, choose the one with the greater number of review statements supporting those two criteria; if still tied, choose the lower-priced product.
gt_steps: Compare the customer reviews for stinging and sticky-feel feedback.
Identify `Banana Boat Kids Vanishing Color, Amazing Apple and Berry Blast Reef Frienfly Broad Spectrum Mineral Sunscreen Foam Twin Pack (Apple & Berry), SPF 50, 4oz. Each` as the standard answer.
Add the product to the shopping cart.
